parameters.name: ChanelType
parameters.description:
The alert notification method. Valid values:

*   Mail: emails
*   DingWebHook: DingTalk chatbots

parameters.name: ChanelValue
parameters.description:
The value specified for the alert notification method.

>  This parameter is required only if you set the `ChanelType` parameter to `Mail`.

parameters.name: ContactName
parameters.description: The name of the alert contact.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

Default value: 100.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms describe-contact-list --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --contact-name Alice --chanel-type Mail --chanel-value Alice@example.com --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms DescribeContactList --region cn-hangzhou --ChanelValue 'Alice@example.com' --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --ChanelType Mail --ContactName Alice
